connectionTypes.sourceNote: SOURCED (secondary) — Arunachal Pradesh (APDoP) commercial LT energy charge of ₹5.65/kWh per bajajfinserv.in, corroborated by Mercom India's coverage of APSERC continuing the existing tariff structure into FY2026-27 (APSERC formally re-adopted the FY2018-19 order for every subsequent year through at least FY2023-24 — see APSERC Petition TP-01 of 2023 order dated 25-10-2023). This ₹5.65 figure is consistent with the file's existing flat ₹4.40 domestic rate, which the same secondary sources corroborate. Fixed charge is NOT separately published for this category in the sources found; assumed same as domestic (₹30/connection/month) pending primary APSERC schedule cross-check.

SOURCED (secondary) — Arunachal Pradesh (APDoP) industrial LT energy charge of ₹4.95/kWh per bajajfinserv.in, corroborated by Mercom India's coverage of APSERC continuing the existing tariff structure into FY2026-27. Fixed charge is NOT separately published for this category in the sources found; assumed same as domestic (₹30/connection/month) pending primary APSERC schedule cross-check.
